title: Position, Role or Label? A Controlled Study of Instruction Conflicts in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.33201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents take instructions from the operator, repository configuration, user, tool results and saved memory, which often conflict. Instruction-hierarchy benchmarks ask whether the higher-ranked source wins, but a source sets position, role and label at once. First, we build WhoWins, 1,080 code-scored scenarios in five task types, each with up to five mutually exclusive instructions, and seven controlled experiments that vary only how instructions are delivered. Second, we study 14 open-weight models (0.6B to 122B, thinking off and on) over 1,887,356 scored replies, checking main findings on held-out scenarios. Inside one message the first of two conflicting lines wins 72.42 to 94.66%, and across messages it keeps 22.95 to 62.65%. A policy sent first in the system (or developer) message loses most conflicts with later lines in every Qwen model but wins most on gpt-oss when it acts. translated_title: 位置、角色还是标签？LLM智能体中指令冲突的受控研究
translated_abstract: LLM智能体会从操作者、仓库配置、用户、工具结果和保存的记忆中接收指令，这些指令经常相互冲突。指令层级基准测试通常询问排名较高的来源是否获胜，但一个来源同时决定了位置、角色和标签。首先，我们构建了WhoWins，这是一个包含五类任务共1,080个由代码自动评分的场景的基准，每个场景最多包含五条互斥指令，并设计了七个仅改变指令传递方式的受控实验。其次，我们研究了14个开放权重模型（参数量从0.6B到122B，分别关闭和开启思考模式），共收集1,887,356条评分回复，并在保留场景上验证了主要发现。在同一条消息内，两条冲突行中的第一行以72.42%至94.66%的比率获胜；跨消息时，第一行仍保持22.95%至62.65%的胜率。在系统（或开发者）消息中首先发送的策略，在所有Qwen模型中与后续指令的冲突大多落败，但在gpt-oss执行操作时大多获胜。在工具和文件写入任务中，其获胜频率低于……
tldr: 该论文构建了包含1,080个受控场景的WhoWins基准，通过对14个开放权重LLM智能体约189万条回复的分析，揭示了指令冲突中独立于角色和标签的强位置效应——首条指令在消息内和跨消息场景中均显著占优。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WhoWins, a benchmark of 1,080 code-scored scenarios with seven controlled experiments, revealing strong position effects in instruction conflicts across 14 open-weight LLM agents over 1.8M scored replies, where the first instruction significantly dominates regardless of role or label.
